scope: Google/Android, RuStore, Capacitor official requirements and localization sources only
limitations: Read-only official documentation refresh; no repository/native build/store-account compliance assessed.
Web retrieval availability and crawl recency are recorded; current documentation can change before RC.
RuStore detailed Pay 11.1.0 integration and runtime English UI remain unresolved; index alone proves only version label.

sources.requirement: Ordinary phone/tablet new apps and updates must target Android 16/API 36 or higher from 2026-08-31. Existing app discoverability floor differs: API 35. An extension to 2026-11-01 can be requested; do not assume it was granted.
sources.evidence: Official English query variant, sections App update requirements and What to do to comply.
sources.initialFetchIssue: Bare registry URL returned Google anti-bot redirect; language variant returned policy.

sources.requirement: Latest listed Play Billing release is 9.1.0, released 2026-06-18. Archive's 9.1.0 is confirmed. 9.0.0 sets library target SDK to 35; that library setting does not override app target API 36 policy.

Handle pending purchases; grant and acknowledge only once PURCHASED. Acknowledge within three days of transition to PURCHASED to avoid refund/revocation. Query purchases on resume to reconcile purchases completed while absent.
sources.evidence: Sections Notify Google the purchase was processed and Handle pending transactions.

sources.requirement: Validate purchase tokens with the backend; grant entitlements only for verified PURCHASED state. Acknowledge non-consumables using the corresponding server API and reconcile voided/refunded orders.
sources.evidence: Sections Move sensitive logic to your backend and Verify purchases before granting entitlements.

sources.requirement: Provide an in-app and store-linked privacy policy on a public, active, non-geofenced, non-editable web URL, not PDF. Account creation requires discoverable in-app and external deletion requests; delete associated data and explain lawful retention.
sources.evidence: Privacy Policy and Account Deletion Requirement.

sources.requirement: Official help index is reachable. It is a routing index, not sufficient evidence for exact listing, App Access, Families, or Data Safety limits; specific linked pages are separately recorded.
sources.evidence: Help index links to review preparation, preview assets, pricing, Data Safety, and app setup.

sources.requirement: Unique name <=30 characters; short description <=80; full description <=4000. At least three screenshots per supplied device type, although 1-10 can upload per batch. Phone screenshot max 3 MB; tablet 5 MB. PNG/JPG; mobile max 2160x3840. At least one developer contact field. Processed draft files expire after 14 days without review submission.
sources.evidence: App info, Developer contact details, Screenshots, and File upload stages.
sources.archiveDelta: Snapshot omits minimum 3 screenshots per device type and claims email universally required; current Console page requires at least one contact, while API page separately requires email.

sources.requirement: Stable complete standalone product; website redirects alone insufficient. Supply reviewer access to all features. Russian or English experience or switch required. Mark app Paid if no free functions. No competing-store links; third-party IP evidence may be requested. Listing/install names and current screenshots must correspond; screenshot text RU/EN and aspect 9:16 or 16:9. RuStore installs should update through RuStore.
sources.evidence: Sections 1-6, including language notice, App type, screenshots.

sources.requirement: Declare actual data categories and sensitive permissions. Dangerous permissions prompt additional review. Complete required declaration fields and check app against review guidelines.
sources.evidence: How to declare app permissions.

sources.requirement: English registry endpoint returned 429 challenge. Russian official overview works and identifies Pay SDK; old billingClient is deprecated. Current Kotlin/Java index lists 11.1.0. Detailed integration and runtime language support remain unverified.
sources.evidence: English URL challenge; Russian overview and Kotlin/Java current-version index.

sources.requirement: Official documentation defaults to Capacitor v8. Native shells bridge the existing web application to native APIs; platform minima and build tools are recorded on dedicated official pages.
sources.evidence: Documentation version navigation v8.

sources.requirement: Transactional edits stage listings and artifacts until commit. Console changes may invalidate edits. Product, in-app product, and subscription APIs do not share this transaction and can take effect immediately. An existing app/upload and Console legal consents are prerequisites.
sources.evidence: Edits overview and Workflow.
sources.implementationImplication: Dry-run allowlist must reject edits.commit, release/submission paths, and all nontransactional product writes by default.

sources.requirement: Identity verification and package/signing-key registration apply to broad Android distribution. Regional enforcement starts 2026-09-30 in Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore, and Thailand; wider rollout follows in 2027+. Play developers use Play Console for on- and off-Play registration.
sources.evidence: Key milestones timeline and Find your path; page updated 2026-08-18.

sources.requirement: Draft creation requires an active app version and allows one draft per app. Missing values inherit active-version data. publishType defaults to INSTANTLY; use MANUAL explicitly. Draft creation differs from moderation submission and publication. API requires minAndroidVersion and developerContacts with email.
sources.evidence: Key Points and Interaction parameters.
sources.documentationConflict: API table says appName maximum 5 characters, conflicting with official Console publication page maximum 30. Treat as documentation inconsistency; verify endpoint schema before upload.

sources.requirement: This registry URL documents icon upload, not binary artifact upload. Icon .jpeg/.png, <=3 MB, 512x512, uploaded to the app/version icon endpoint with Public-Token.
sources.evidence: Title and Restrictions; POST /public/v1/application/{packageName}/version/{versionId}/image/icon.
sources.archiveDelta: Registry key mentions artifact/icon but exact URL only covers icon.

sources.requirement: Listing is localized by BCP-47 language tag. Localized fields include title, fullDescription, shortDescription and video. Maintain distinct en-US and ru-RU payloads.
sources.evidence: Listing resource Fields.

sources.requirement: PUT updates or creates listing within packageName/editId/language path. Request and response use Listing; androidpublisher OAuth scope is required.
sources.evidence: HTTP request, Path parameters, Authorization scopes.

sources.requirement: REST reference includes edits and separate state-mutating resources. Presence in the same API does not make all operations draft-only; use endpoint-specific allowlisting.
sources.evidence: REST resource index; Edits guide supplies transaction semantics.

sources.requirement: Android 13+ offers system per-app languages. Publish LocaleConfig and integrate public locale APIs; provide backward compatibility for older devices. setApplicationLocales recreates Activity by default unless app handles locale configuration changes. Automatic locale generation can unintentionally include library locales.
sources.evidence: System settings, Implement using AndroidX, locale configuration-change note.
sources.implementationImplication: Explicitly handle native locale configuration changes, synchronize web locale in place, and test Activity/WebView/Canvas identity preservation. This is an engineering inference from platform behavior and the user's invariant.

sources.requirement: LocaleConfig is available from API 33 and lists supported app locales using BCP47. Check status for absent/malformed configuration. getDefaultLocale is API 35+, so gate calls on older supported Android versions.
sources.evidence: getStatus, getSupportedLocales, getDefaultLocale.

sources.requirement: Complete default resources are mandatory. Missing default values can fail app startup in unsupported locales. Supply every needed default string/resource and complete RU/EN variants; test unsupported locale fallback.
sources.evidence: Why default resources are important and Create default resources.

sources.requirement: Localized graphics must be provided with translated listings or default-language graphics appear. Play's Gemini app-string automation may override supplied translations in selected languages and future bundles. Keep RU/EN under controlled human-reviewed workflow; automatic store translation is not accepted as V12 evidence.
sources.evidence: If you don't add or purchase translations; App strings translation using Gemini.
sources.implementationImplication: Do not enable automated replacement for RU/EN: it would invalidate reviewed string hashes and exact-RC evidence.

sources.requirement: Custom store listings are not automatically translated. They use their selected default language unless translations are added; an existing published default listing is a prerequisite for creating custom listings.
sources.evidence: Translations and Create a custom store listing.

sources.requirement: English query variant was opened and matches per-app-language guidance recorded for the canonical URL.
sources.evidence: System settings and in-app locale APIs.

sources.requirement: English query variant was opened and confirms complete default resources and locale-specific resource testing.
sources.evidence: Why default resources are important.

sources.requirement: Version 7 new-app/update deadline was 2026-08-31, extension 2026-11-01. Version 8 deadline 2027-08-31; version 9 deadline 2028-08-31. Therefore use supported 8+ absent an approved v7 extension; selected latest 9.1.0 still requires integration validation.
sources.evidence: Support timeline table; page updated 2026-09-04.

sources.requirement: Capacitor 8: Node 22+, Xcode 26.0+, macOS to build iOS, Android Studio 2025.2.1+ and Android SDK. Swift Package Manager is recommended; CocoaPods remains optional if dependencies require it.
sources.evidence: Core Requirements, iOS Requirements and Android Requirements.

sources.requirement: Capacitor v8 supports Android API 24+ and Android WebView/Chrome 60+. Emulator WebView does not automatically update. These runtime minima do not override Play's app target API policy or actual WebGL feature/device testing.
sources.evidence: Android Support and Running Your App.

sources.requirement: Capacitor v8 supports iOS 15+ with Xcode 26.0+ and WKWebView. Native iOS build/run requires Xcode environment; source preparation on Windows is not a signed iOS artifact.
sources.evidence: iOS Support and Running Your App.

sources.requirement: Declare ads, target audience, sensitive permissions, ratings and privacy; children in target audience trigger Families policy. Provide sign-in access information for restricted app functionality.

sources.requirement: Review credentials/instructions must be in English, reusable, always valid and location-independent, with a way around OTP/MFA restrictions. Give access to all restricted/paywalled functions and explain PIN flows.
sources.evidence: Requirements for providing sign-in details.

sources.requirement: Icon 512x512 PNG <=1024 KB; feature graphic 1024x500 JPEG/24-bit PNG without alpha. Screenshots: at least two overall, up to eight per type; JPEG/24-bit PNG; usual dimension 320-3840 and longest <=2x shortest. Large-screen guidance uses four screenshots at 1080-7680, 16:9/9:16. Show actual app, localized text, and concise alt descriptions.
sources.evidence: App icon, Feature graphic, Screenshots.
sources.implementationImplication: Capture exact RC in RU/EN separately; validate per-device rules rather than one global dimension limit.

sources.requirement: An app offered for free cannot later be converted to paid under the same package. Configure intended paid-upfront model before public availability. Payments profile and per-country availability govern sales.
sources.evidence: Make your app free or paid.

sources.requirement: Data Safety must cover actual app and third-party SDK data collection, sharing, security, and purposes. Device-only access with no off-device transfer is not collection in this form. No-data apps still need accurate form and policy.
sources.evidence: Disclosure guidance and Optional format for SDKs.

sources.requirement: Declare true audience and child-appropriate content. Mixed audience must prevent collection from children by unsuitable SDKs or gate such SDKs appropriately; child/unknown-age persistent identifiers are restricted. Monetization must avoid deceptive or manipulative child targeting. Use full policy over summary.
sources.evidence: Families Policy Requirements and Ads and Monetization.
